clean.list_omitted: 50 rows omitted from the public release (per-wallet data is not published); the method and aggregates are complete

field_dictionary.activity_score: n_trades x n_markets — rank key of the clean list
field_dictionary.buy_usd: observed buy notional (USD) inside the snapshot window
field_dictionary.is_farm: repeated-volume pattern label derived from sig_share; labels a pattern, not intent
field_dictionary.label: public Polymarket username when the profile is named
field_dictionary.life_days: days between the wallet's first and last observed print
field_dictionary.n_buys: observed BUY prints inside the snapshot window
field_dictionary.n_markets: distinct markets traded inside the snapshot window
field_dictionary.n_trades: observed prints inside the snapshot window
field_dictionary.near_certain_share: share of buy dollars at near-certain prices (continuous, 0-1)
field_dictionary.sell_usd: observed sell notional (USD) inside the snapshot window
field_dictionary.sig_share: share of buy dollars matching farm signatures (continuous, 0-1)
field_dictionary.wallet: proxy wallet address as observed in the public trade feed

method.contest: believe a wallet is mis-flagged? use https://github.com/ailinsun/MarketFlow/issues — corrections land in the snapshot changelog
method.farm_signature: BUY prints at price >= 0.99 grouped by exact (condition_id, size); a group is a farm signature when >=5 wallets repeat it across >=20 prints; a wallet is flagged when >=80% of its observed buy dollars land on such signatures.

raw.list_omitted: 50 rows omitted from the public release (per-wallet data is not published); the method and aggregates are complete
